request:
Which modules of the click library (src/click/) import from both src/click/_compat.py and src/click/utils.py but do not import from src/click/core.py at all? Count every import statement, including imports inside functions and under type-checking guards. Give the repository-relative file path.

Requested output columns: file_path (string).
explanation: The query joins imports with files to filter for click modules in src/click/, then checks that both _compat and utils are imported while core is not imported.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT f.file_id AS file_path
FROM code.imports imp
JOIN code.files f ON imp.file_id = f.file_id
WHERE f.package = 'click'
  AND f.module LIKE 'src/click/%'
  AND imp.imported_file_id IN (
      (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = '_compat')
      AND
      (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = 'utils')
  )
  AND imp.file_id NOT IN (
      SELECT imp2.file_id
      FROM code.imports imp2
      JOIN code.files f2 ON imp2.imported_file_id = f2.file_id
      WHERE f2.module = 'core'
  )
